{{short description|American atmospheric scientist}}
'''William B. Rossow''' is an American atmospheric scientist, who was for many years the head of the [[International Satellite Cloud Climatology Project]]. He is currently a distinguished professor at [[City College of New York]],<ref name="CUNY">{{Cite web |url=https://www.ccny.cuny.edu/profiles/william-rossow |title=William Rossow |publisher=cuny.edu |accessdate=November 30, 2016}}</ref> and also a published author.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=KMFMjSkAAAAJ&hl=en |title=William B Rossow |accessdate=November 30, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.worldcat.org/identities/lccn-n86830802/ |title=Rossow, William Brigance |publisher=worldcat.org |accessdate=November 30, 2016}}</ref> He is a Fellow of the [[American Geophysical Union]] and [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref name="CUNY"/>
